scope: Production Readiness Audit - Core Components (excluding wallet, unidoc, payment pages)

criticalBugs.issue: Race condition in toggleFollow - reading count, decrementing/incrementing separately, then updating. Two simultaneous follow/unfollow operations can result in count mismatches.
criticalBugs.fix: Use Firestore transactions or use increment() function: `followingCount: increment(isFollowing ? -1 : 1)` instead of manual increment/decrement

criticalBugs.issue: Promise.all with no catch handler for failed user fetches. If any user document fetch fails, entire conversation list update silently fails due to unhandled rejection.
criticalBugs.fix: Add .catch() handler: `Promise.all(promises).then(...).catch(err => console.error('Error loading conversations:', err))`

criticalBugs.issue: Same as above - per-user conversations Promise.all has unhandled error chain. Errors are logged with console.error but state update may not happen, leaving UI in inconsistent state.
criticalBugs.fix: Add proper error handling and fallback state update

criticalBugs.issue: After Google sign-in, accessing user.email without null check. If googleUser object is null, will crash with 'Cannot read property email of null'
criticalBugs.fix: Add validation: `if (!user || !user.email) { throw new Error('Invalid user object'); }`

criticalBugs.issue: Race condition in conversation creation. Double-check for existing conversation happens AFTER setActiveConvoId is called. If two rapid clicks occur, two conversations may be created.
criticalBugs.fix: Lock conversation creation with a flag or move race-condition check before setActiveConvoId

criticalBugs.issue: Stats state initialized as null but accessed directly in multiple places (line 262, 305) without null checks. Will throw 'Cannot read property of null' at runtime.
criticalBugs.fix: Initialize stats with default empty object: `useState({ postsCreated: 0, followers: 0, following: 0, connectionsCount: 0 })` and always use stats?.property

criticalBugs.issue: Missing null check on post.authorId in fetching avatar. If post.authorId is undefined/null, getDoc fails silently.
handleFileChange converts file to base64 but size check is done on original file. File size validation should happen BEFORE conversion to avoid memory issues with large files.
criticalBugs.fix: Check file.size FIRST: `if (file.size > 2 * 1024 * 1024) { toast.error(...); return; }` BEFORE FileReader

criticalBugs.issue: Email/password validation missing. No check for valid email format, password length validation only happens in UI but backend has no validation.
criticalBugs.fix: Add: `const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/; if (!emailRegex.test(formData.email)) setError('Invalid email format');`

criticalBugs.issue: Unsafe timestamp conversion. Code doesn't check if lastTimestamp.toDate is a function before calling it. If data format changes, will throw 'toDate is not a function'
criticalBugs.fix: Add safe conversion: `const ts = data.lastTimestamp && typeof data.lastTimestamp.toDate === 'function' ? data.lastTimestamp.toDate() : new Date(data.lastTimestamp)`

criticalBugs.issue: After re-authentication fails, setIsLoading(false) is called but error is only console.logged. User sees no visual feedback of failure.
criticalBugs.fix: Move error handling to catch all auth errors: wrap entire block in try-catch with proper user feedback

criticalBugs.issue: Multiple Firestore queries without abort/cleanup on unmount. If user navigates away before queries complete, setters update unmounted component.
criticalBugs.fix: Use mounted flag in all async operations to prevent setState on unmounted component

criticalBugs.issue: Auth state change listener doesn't return unsubscribe. Multiple listeners may accumulate if component remounts.
criticalBugs.fix: Currently returns unsub correctly, but verify all useEffect dependencies are correct to prevent re-creation

warnings.issue: Multiple useEffect hooks (lines 44, 133, 151, 178, 202) with auth.currentUser dependency. All have onAuthStateChanged which will trigger on every auth state change. Potential for multiple simultaneous listeners.
Follow/unfollow operations fetch user data twice (line 127-147) - before update to check state, then again to get new counts. This is inefficient and creates window for count mismatches.
useEffect for post fetch (line 114) has empty dependency array but location.hash changes trigger scroll effect. Posts list could become stale if data updates.
useEffect at line 195 sets user state in onChange callback but dependency array doesn't prevent stale closures on subsequent renders.
URL.createObjectURL called without cleanup in handleFileChange. Refs leak if component unmounts during file selection.
File upload in drag-drop handler doesn't validate file type. Any file can be uploaded without checking for valid document types.
Avatar URLs hardcoded as null in multiple places (lines 323, 406, 407, 740, 808, 925). Should use getDefaultAvatar() instead.
Connection request creation may fail silently if array operations fail partway through. Transaction should wrap entire operation.

recommendations.item: Add email format validation to both login and registration forms using regex or email-validator library
Implement token refresh logic - JWT tokens should be refreshed before expiration
Create global error boundary component to catch unhandled React errors and display user-friendly messages
Add retry logic for failed Firestore operations with exponential backoff
Create centralized validation utility with schema validation (e.g., using zod or yup) for all user input
Add file upload validation: check MIME type, file size, and scan for malicious content
Wrap frequently updated list components (InboxPage conversations, CampusFeed posts) with React.memo to prevent unnecessary re-renders
Implement pagination for conversations and posts lists to reduce DOM nodes and improve rendering performance
Use useCallback for all event handlers passed to memoized components to prevent re-creation on parent render
Replace manual increment/decrement with Firestore increment() function in toggleFollow, toggleConnectionStatus functions
Add Firestore security rules to validate all mutations on server-side, don't trust client validation
Consider Context API or Redux for global state (user, notifications, unread counts) to avoid prop drilling and multiple listeners
Add JSDoc or TypeScript interfaces for all data objects to catch null/undefined errors at development time
Audit all useEffect hooks - ensure all async subscriptions are properly cleaned up in return function
Never store sensitive data in localStorage/sessionStorage. Move to secure HTTP-only cookies for auth tokens
Add unit tests for all utility functions (validation, avatar service, profile service) with >80% coverage
Add integration tests for auth flows (login, registration, logout) and error scenarios
Add Sentry or similar error tracking to capture runtime errors in production
Document all Firestore data schemas and validation rules

performanceIssues.issue: Multiple Promise.all operations in useEffect without debouncing. Conversation list can trigger 100+ async operations on load.
performanceIssues.solution: Batch user fetches, implement request caching

performanceIssues.issue: Stats computed from multiple separate queries instead of single aggregated read
performanceIssues.solution: Use Firestore aggregation queries or batch reads

performanceIssues.issue: Comment likes subscribed individually for each comment (useEffect at line 258+)

securityIssues.issue: No CSRF token protection visible in forms
Base64 encoded files stored in Firestore documents
securityIssues.recommendation: Move files to Firebase Storage instead of embedded in documents

securityIssues.issue: No input sanitization visible for user-generated content
securityIssues.recommendation: Sanitize all user inputs with DOMPurify before storing in Firestore

securityIssues.issue: File uploads have no virus scanning
securityIssues.recommendation: Integrate virus scanning service (ClamAV, VirusTotal API)

overallReadiness.summary: Multiple critical race conditions, unhandled errors, and null pointer issues could cause runtime crashes or data consistency problems. Requires fixes to: (1) Race conditions in parallel database operations, (2) Comprehensive error handling for all async operations, (3) Input validation for all user-submitted data, (4) Null safety checks throughout component renders.
blockers: CRITICAL: Race conditions in toggleFollow must be fixed with Firestore transactions
CRITICAL: All Promise.all chains need error handling - currently silent failures
CRITICAL: Stats state null initialization will cause runtime crashes
CRITICAL: Email validation missing on registration
HIGH: Conversation creation race condition can duplicate conversations

criticalPathFixes.task: Fix race conditions in toggleFollow (profileService.js) using Firestore transactions
Add error handlers to all Promise.all chains in async operations
Add null checks for all state objects before rendering/accessing properties
Implement email validation on registration and login
Add proper error boundaries and user feedback for all auth operations
